feature_summary: Mean of existing relative features; min, max and std for features varying within training weeks. Replace hourly calendar columns with case-start month sine/cosine. Select nonconstant columns on pre-2021 training inputs only.
target: Fraction of the 168 hours with Lio ON
correction: One constant logit offset per case, matching the predicted weekly ON fraction. Full correction only; no strength selection.
gate: Both weekly ON-hours MAE and full ensemble micro ROC-AUC must improve. Screen 2021 first; if it passes, require improvement for native and frozen 2022, all cases and Jan7 onward. Otherwise stop.
